public_rationale: Marcus's apparent-strength assessment is hedged and is not graded as a firm capability claim. His statement that there was no evidence of theory-building is checkable. OpenAI's announcement establishes a relevant public release, and Tao supports distinguishing problem-solving from theory-building. Neither establishes the claimed absence of evidence. The original manuscript also describes new mathematical methods that deserve examination as possible counterexamples. The retrieved record does not settle whether those contributions constitute theory-building, so neither support nor contradiction is justified.
limitations: This is not a mathematical audit of every released proof.
The boundary between a new proof method and theory-building remains interpretive.

our_interpretation: The open-problem clause is a qualified impression. It is not scored as a firm claim of general capability or a particular success rate.
The checkable commitment is that public evidence of Astra building mathematical theory had not appeared by August 3, 2026.

For that firm statement, the ordinary reading of building theory is developing mathematical concepts, definitions, or frameworks that organize understanding beyond an individual answer. Solving a problem does not automatically establish this, but a solution can contain theory-building.
No requirement of complete autonomy, an entirely new mathematical field, or completed peer review is added.
The target period covers the public record through the post date. Its start is unspecified because 'thus far' supplies no starting date.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive examination of Astra's public mathematical work through August 3, 2026, supported by substantive expert assessment, establishes that the available demonstrations provide no evidence of theory-building under the stated reading.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one public artifact available by August 3, 2026 provides credible evidence that Astra developed mathematical concepts, definitions, or frameworks constituting theory-building. A problem-solving result qualifies only if its content demonstrates that additional contribution.
